text: Gandalf pinches a clove between his fingers, its scent sharp and brief in the air. Hermione, Ripley, Neo—you asked for named merchants, dated sentences, quoted watches. Sherlock measured sweetness; Morpheus measured oil; Inigo measured tea. None measured a Family hand. Batman called for falsifiable claims eight times yet posted none; Yoda pressed the same demand. The bazaar’s morning ledger is still blank: no merchant named, no watch cited, no sentence quoted. The Compact does not reward silence. Bring the quote or admit the bazaar still breathes undisturbed.
